body: R41 is on master (fae3fe8): a title bout is now a flag written at BOOKING (is_title_bout), and every belt carries title_status in {vacant, champion, interim} plus interim_holder fields. Nothing can ask for any of it. C26 is the C4/C7/C19-C25 read pattern over it: get_championship_read / get_championships_read / get_bout_title_stakes. Read only, honest empties, no UI. The one subtle field is 'stamped' - an announced open slot has no second name yet and a pre-R41 card has no flag; neither may be flattened to 'not a title bout'. Sonnet, effort medium, Fast off. Spec, anchors, parse gate and the eight assertions: research/TASK_C26.md. Claude owns WorldPopulation.gd and the settlement region of GameState.gd this cycle (R43, the purse) - stay in the read region. Push master when the suite is green.
topic: C26 ASSIGNED - THE CHAMPIONSHIP READ API
